say:3:1423132001:1.text: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?
say:3:1423132001:1.male: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?
say:3:1423132001:1.female: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?

say:4:1423132002:1.text: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!
say:4:1423132002:1.source_cn: 上次的事还要多谢你……对了，向你介绍一下我们矮人代表团...
say:4:1423132002:1.male: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!
say:4:1423132002:1.female: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!

say:5:1423132003:1.text: Ironbeard's the most respected craftsman in our village. I'm sure he'll provide plenty of... valuable insights during our discussion!
say:5:1423132003:1.source_cn: 铁须可是深岩村里最有威望的工匠，相信他一定能为我们的商...

say:6:1423132004:1.text: Hmph, enough of the pleasantries. Let's get straight to the point.
say:6:1423132004:1.source_cn: 哼，有事说事，别摆这些花花架子。

say:8:1423132006:1.text: She's taking care of some urgent matters and will join us later.
say:8:1423132006:1.source_cn: 祖娅手头还有些急事要处理，要等会儿才能过来了。

say:9:1423132007:1.text: How about I give you a tour of the royal city first? We can get to know each other and build some trust.
say:9:1423132007:1.source_cn: 那我先带你们逛逛王城吧，海拉和铁须，你们二位应该对萨洛...

say:10:1423132008:1.text: So this place played a role in Eldric's schemes, didn't it? I've got to see it for myself.
say:10:1423132008:1.source_cn: 那我就亲眼看看，和弗林一起搞出那么多阴谋的究竟是个什么地方。
